preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the input string s with all occurrences of the fillers 'ogo', 'ogogo', and 'ogogogo' replaced with '***'.
